text:
Tom (CS): Quick capture from onboarding calls — recurring wishlist vs actual blockers. Trying to triage what should go to product backlog vs enablement. Top themes: prompt templates, per-route billing visibility, SSO token rotate 401s.

Maya (PM): thanks Tom — can you paste the raw items here? we can tag high/med/low and owners.

Tom (CS): sure, pasted below — kept concise: 
- Prompt templates: customers want canned templates + example prompts for common workloads (summaries, classification, codegen).
- Per-route billing: customers ask to see cost per API route/model in console and exportable breakdowns.
- SSO token rotate: a few tenants hit 401 cascade after key rotation, intermittent.
- Streaming SDK docs: some confusion around client reconnect semantics.

Liam (Eng): per-route billing looks like telemetry + DB schema work. rough ballpark: 2 weeks to add event tags + export endpoint, then UI.

Priya (CSM): important note — one customer said they'd pay for early access to per-route billing. that ups priority.

Aria (SRE): SSO 401s — do we have a repro? Tom, can you share the log snippet you mentioned?

Tom (CS): pasted small log block (redacted):
```
2026-03-18T14:02:32Z auth: token-rotate triggered for tenant: brightlane
2026-03-18T14:02:35Z proxy: 401 returned from idp for /v1/route/stream
2026-03-18T14:02:35Z runtime: retry allowed=false, user-facing 401
```
Seems like some requests hit old cache entries before refresh.

Aria (SRE): that looks like a cache invalidation race. I'll try to reproduce locally against staging IDP. could be a short hotfix.

triage-bot: Created GH issue #4521 and linked onboarding notes (labels: cs-reported, needs-triage).

Maya (PM): plan proposal:
- Quick wins (1): prompt templates + streaming docs clarifications — owned by product + doc sprints.
- Medium (2): per-route billing MVP — scope as telemetry tagging + CSV export; engineering to estimate.
- Hotfix (SRE): SSO 401 reproduce + patch.

Maya (PM): assigning: @Priya gather 5 sample prompts + customer examples; @Liam scope per-route billing work and provide tentative ETA; @Aria triage SSO logs and attempt repro. I'll slot quick wins into next week's doc sprint.

Priya (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll collect the prompts and ask the paying-customer to sign an NDA/early-access note. will have a one-pager by Fri.

Liam (Eng): quick scoping note: per-route billing will touch billing-events schema and cost-aggregation pipeline. phased approach:
- phase A: add route_id tag to events + export endpoint (2w)
- phase B: UI per-route cost breakdown (3w)
I'll post a short tech plan in GH #4521.

Tom (CS): adding customer priorities: Brightlane (high), NorthBay (medium), ACME (low). Brightlane confirmed willingness to pilot.

Aria (SRE): if I can reproduce SSO 401 in staging, I can open a patch PR same day. otherwise need trace from customer. Tom, can you ask them for request-id headers?

Tom (CS): will request request-ids and redacted traces now. also happy to drop full transcripts into GH if helpful (redacted).

Maya (PM): great — I'll mark items in roadmap as sales-validated when Priya confirms commitments. Thanks team.

Tom (CS): thanks all — ping here for anything urgent.
